why: A per-axis cell's occupancy is the product of its cuts' coverages at 32 divisions an axis; these volumes are the law's witnesses, so a shaper's share cannot be an assertion dressed as a measurement.
recipe: cargo run -p voxel-model --example profile32-shapes; Cell::volume over the 32^3 grid
